title: Explainable boosting machine predicts co-occurring neuropathologies in dementia
summary: An explainable boosting machine classifier chain predicted seven neuropathologic outcomes in 1463 autopsied ROSMAP participants and was externally validated in 2613 NACC participants. Macro-averaged AUROC was 0.80 in ROSMAP and 0.77 in NACC; a 15-predictor model had lower burden and reduced performance. The authors call for prospective evaluation in diverse populations.
ai_technology: Explainable boosting machine classifier chain on multidomain predictors

evidence.tested: Development in ROSMAP (n=1463) and external validation in NACC (n=2613).
evidence.unknown: Autopsy-based cohorts; moderate performance; no prospective evaluation; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Interpretable machine learning predicts several neuropathologies jointly from multidomain predictors.
